author: /root/construct_integer_witnesses
claim: Positive-step orbit closure equals the identity component when the actual step returns to that component, for a dense cyclic topological abelian group.

obligations.name: Original topological group
obligations.required_input: Topological abelian group with a dense integer orbit.
obligations.constructed_input: The exact G, a, topology and DenseRange input are unchanged throughout.
obligations.justification: No real chart, independent factor or abstract replacement of G is used.

obligations.name: Closed step subgroup
obligations.required_input: Closure of integer multiples of the actual k a.
obligations.constructed_input: stepClosure a k is AddSubgroup.zmultiples (k smul a), followed by topologicalClosure.
obligations.justification: The same step appears in the quotient kernel and final recurrence.

obligations.name: Quotient separation
obligations.required_input: T1 quotient so finite subsets are closed.
obligations.constructed_input: The actual quotient by the closed H has the pinned quotient topology.

obligations.name: Finite cyclic coverage
obligations.required_input: The finite orbit must cover the full quotient.
obligations.constructed_input: k kills q(a), and the quotient orbit is dense via the continuous surjective quotient map.
obligations.justification: A finite closed dense orbit equals univ; no finite-index premise is assumed.

obligations.name: Component inclusion
obligations.required_input: G^0 lies in the actual step closure.
obligations.constructed_input: The finite T1 quotient is discrete, making H clopen.
obligations.justification: IsClopen.connectedComponent_subset applies because zero belongs to H.

obligations.name: Reverse inclusion
obligations.required_input: The chosen step must belong to the component.
obligations.constructed_input: Explicit hstep: k a belongs to connectedComponent zero.
obligations.justification: Integer multiples remain in the identity-component subgroup; closedness retains their limits.

obligations.name: Divisible step and residue
obligations.required_input: Final progression step/residue must return to G^0.
obligations.constructed_input: An explicit m a in G^0 passes to k when m divides k; translate membership remains explicit.
obligations.justification: Existence of a positive m is not assumed proved, and no final CRT residue is silently changed.

obligations.name: Actual target and positive tails
obligations.required_input: One target open set must meet G^0, with the same actual translate.
obligations.constructed_input: U, IsOpen U, and a point in U intersect G^0 remain explicit inputs.
obligations.justification: Compact recurrence is applied at x-b, using the exact step-closure equality.

obligations.name: Downstream scope and validation
obligations.required_input: A helper cannot stand in for full arithmetic completeness.
obligations.constructed_input: No scalar-region construction, actual component modulus, final CRT access, or later source rows is claimed.
obligations.justification: Source policy passes only; hosted compilation and separate acceptance remain pending.
